problem_statement:
Signup: Selecting "Online Store" results in a blank screen


#### Steps to reproduce
1. Starting at URL: https://wordpress.com/start/
2. Pick the "Online Store" segment
3. Notice how a blank screen is being displayed instead of the Domain Search page

Note: This happened when I was in an Incognito window.

#### What I expected
To be taken to the next step which is Domain Search

#### What happened instead
I was shown a blank screen

Edit: These were the errors captured by @jblz  and @creativecoder:

![Screenshot 2019-07-22 10 39 34](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4924246/61652573-1974ab80-ac6d-11e9-82d8-ce764b45c22e.png)

![Screenshot 2019-07-22 10 39 25](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4924246/61652579-1c6f9c00-ac6d-11e9-985d-9b9006d70c00.png)

#### Browser / OS version
Google Chrome Version 75.0.3770.142
MacOS Mojave 10.14.2

#### Screenshot / Video
https://cloudup.com/c2kEkexQRrW - it's the first few seconds on this video. This happened twice and I was able to record it the second time. Refreshing fixed it.

cc @jblz @creativecoder @michaeldcain
